text: K1/K2's table lookup with one hand-made change: the key word starting again at an unseen sentence break, enciphering and deciphering taking turns, or the table read from the right or the bottom (reversed alphabets).
Each known run's forced key was looked for in every stretch of every one of 234,451 words written round and round, on 64 tables and 3 forms: no word matches even one run, on K4 or any of 50 shuffles.
With the form switching by letter, by known run or by carved line, no key shorter than 26 fits the 24 letters (25 on the 20 official ones), as on the shuffles (p 0.69 and 1.00).
Six messages with a restarted key word and four with alternating forms are all found, on both sets of known letters.
